title: Terengganu led real median income growth in 2016–2024 at 25.4%.
subtitle: Median gross monthly household income; RM at 2010 prices; cumulative change (%) over 2016–2024 and 2019–2024
notes: Each state uses its own annual average overall CPI (12 months); original CPI base 2010 = 100.
Real-income levels are for change over time within a state; CPI is not a comparison of price levels across states.
Ranks use unrounded growth. Growth is cumulative, not annualised.
headline: Terengganu led real median income growth in 2016–2024 at 25.4%. For 2019–2024, Selangor led at 16.9%.
